description: Where this LinkJolt account is in setting up its affiliate program: the business name and website, the launch steps (business details, campaign, payment connection, first affiliate, first sale) with the next one to do, the tracking script tag for the site and whether it has been seen, and each campaign's join link. Call it first when helping someone set up or launch. When business.needsDetails is true the name is a placeholder LinkJolt made at sign-up (from the email domain, or the person's first name): ask for the real one. Connecting Stripe or another payment platform can only be done by the person in the browser; connectLinks gives Stripe's one-click link for this account and the page for the others. Requires Pro plan or higher, or a new account that has not picked a plan yet.
name: get_setup_status
title: Get setup status
